summary: Iteration 118 — Tested the new Geo IP enrichment, country filtering (OR logic), E.164 phone validation and geo-aware spam scoring plus anti-spam regression across all lead endpoints. Backend: 50/51 pytest pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration118_geo_phone.py). VERIFIED: lookup_geo_ip resolves real IPs via ip-api (94.200.5.9 -> AE/Dubai/du, 8.8.8.8 -> US/Ashburn) and returns empty country for 127.0.0.1/::1/private/empty IPs; results are cached in _geo_cache. POST /api/leads persists geo.country / geo.country_name / geo.city / geo.region / geo.isp + ip + spam_score on the Mongo lead doc (verified via pymongo for both an AE-spoofed X-Forwarded-For and 8.8.8.8); /api/quick-inquiry also persists geo. Country OR logic works end-to-end: from a JP IP (not in ALLOWED_COUNTRIES) a lead with no phone -> 422 'We currently serve the UAE, GCC...' while the same JP IP with +971501234567 or the UAE local 0501234567 -> 200. Phone validation: '12', '123456', 16-digit and 19-digit numbers -> 422 with the phone hint; '0501234567' (AE_LOCAL), '+971501234567' (AE), '+966501234567' (SA), '+974 5512 3456' (QA), '00971501234567' (AE), '+1 415 555 2671' (US) and empty phone all accepted; unknown '+999...' -> OTHER. Anti-spam regression intact: mailinator -> 422, spam content -> 422, gibberish name -> 422, invalid email -> 422, honeypot fax -> silent 200 leadId 'ok', per-IP rate limit trips on the 11th request. Endpoint coverage all 200: /api/leads, /api/quick-inquiry, /api/signage-inquiry, /api/cpd/request, /api/franchise-request, /api/technical-support, /api/specpacks/retail-hospitality/download, /api/site-visit-request, /api/design-assist/request, /api/chat/lead; invalid phone also correctly 422s on /api/signage-inquiry. GET /api/health -> ok. FRONTEND: /contact loads, invalid phone '12' surfaces the backend message in [data-testid="contact-form-error"], valid submit -> POST /api/leads 200 + [data-testid="success-message"], and the UI-created lead stored geo {country: US, city: Council Bluffs, isp: Google LLC} (preview egress IP, as expected).

minor.issue: GCC -10 bonus + max(0, score) clamp flattens all low-signal leads to 0, so the +5 free-email (gmail) penalty is invisible for the primary market — a gmail lead and a corporate lead from an AE IP both score 0. Apply the geo bonus as a floor-aware adjustment (or clamp only at the end after keeping relative deltas) if the score is meant to be used for triage.

Uses the free ip-api.com endpoint over plain HTTP (no TLS) and its free tier is limited to 45 req/min and licensed for non-commercial use only. On 429/timeout it fails open (empty geo -> country check bypassed). Consider an HTTPS/keyed provider for production and log when a lookup fails so silent bypass is visible.

Adds up to 5s of blocking latency to every lead POST (httpx timeout=5) inside the request path; measured submissions took ~1s but a slow provider directly slows the form. Cache pruning also computes an unused `cutoff` variable and then clears the whole cache (dead code).
PHONE_RE is declared but never used; validate_phone never rejects on format, only on digit count — e.g. 'abc1234567' or '++++1234567' pass as UNKNOWN. Consider using PHONE_RE or drop it.

Phones with an unrecognised country code return 'OTHER' and are treated as no-phone, so a legitimate lead from a non-listed country with an unlisted code is blocked; blocking messages are not persisted anywhere (only logged), so blocked-lead volume is invisible to the business.

STILL OPEN: rate-limit slot is consumed before check_recaptcha; project_planner.py swallows reCAPTCHA errors; specpacks/downloads honeypot response distinguishable; Mongo _id leaked by /api/admin/leads.

issues: The fixed cookie-consent banner ([data-testid="cookie-consent-banner"]) overlays the bottom of the viewport and intercepts pointer events on the 'GET QUOTE IN 2 HOURS' submit button when it is scrolled into the lower part of the screen — Playwright's normal click was blocked until the banner was accepted. Real users on shorter viewports can hit the same dead-click. Add bottom padding to the page while the banner is visible (or raise the form's z-index/scroll offset).
Carry-over from iteration 117: success card keeps the previous scroll offset leaving a large empty area below; scroll-to-top on success would read better.

action_items: Fix spam-score flattening: the GCC -10 bonus plus max(0,...) clamp makes free-email vs corporate indistinguishable (both 0) for AE/GCC leads (the one failing test documents this).
Harden the geo provider: use HTTPS/keyed lookup, log lookup failures/rate-limit (currently fails open silently) and consider moving the lookup off the request path or lowering the 5s timeout.
Remove dead code in anti_spam.py (unused PHONE_RE, unused `cutoff` in cache prune) and decide whether phone format (not just digit count) should be validated.
Consider persisting blocked-country attempts (count/geo) so the country filter's business impact is measurable.
Add bottom spacing so the cookie-consent banner cannot intercept clicks on the contact submit button.

Carry-over from iteration 117: rate-limit slot consumed before reCAPTCHA, project_planner silent reCAPTCHA bypass, distinguishable honeypot response on specpacks/downloads, Mongo _id in /api/admin/leads.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_spam_score applies the geo bonus before clamping at 0, destroying all sub-10 signal for GCC leads — the free-email penalty documented in the requirements is effectively dead for the primary market.
Country filtering fails open on any geo lookup failure (empty country string), so an ip-api 429/timeout silently disables the whole filter with only a debug-level warning; add an explicit log/metric.
Every lead POST now performs a synchronous outbound HTTP call to a third-party free API inside the request; a provider outage adds 5s per submission to every one of the 13 lead endpoints.

success_rate.backend: 98% (50/51 pytest; the single failure is the documented spam-score clamp issue)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (/contact loads, invalid phone error surfaced, valid submit 200 + success card + geo persisted)

seed_data_creation: ~29 TEST_i118_* prefixed leads/inquiries plus 2 UI leads (qa118.badphone@brightretail.ae rejected, qa118b.geo@brightretail.ae accepted). All safe to purge by the TEST_i118 / qa118 prefix.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration118_geo_phone.py. Key helpers: uae_ip() generates unique 94.200.x.y IPs that ip-api resolves to AE (avoids both the 10/hour per-IP rate limiter AND the country filter); 8.8.8.8 -> US; 133.242.0.1 -> JP is used as the 'blocked country' probe (test skips itself if that IP ever starts resolving to an allowed country). Geo persistence is verified directly with pymongo (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env) because there is no public read API for leads. Preview egress IP is 104.198.x (Google/US) so browser-submitted leads always store US geo and are never country-blocked. Contact.js testids: input-name/company/email/phone/city/application/message, lead-capture-submit-button, contact-form-error, success-message — ACCEPT the cookie banner first or the submit click is intercepted. The only failing test (test_gcc_bonus_does_not_flatten_scores_to_zero) is an intentional documentation of the spam-score clamp bug; it should pass once compute_spam_score is fixed.
rca_of_the_issue: Spam-score flattening: compute_spam_score subtracts 10 for GCC countries and then returns max(0, min(score,100)). A clean corporate lead scores 0 and a gmail lead scores 5; after the -10 GCC bonus both clamp to 0, so the free-email signal (and any other <=10 penalty) is lost precisely for the primary target market. Everything else in the geo/phone/country feature set behaved as specified.
